source.title: Named original-output search: Dragonflight prospecting and milling raw-operation evidence

notes: Fresh multi-site name-first attempt prioritized material-by-material operation event logs and quality-rank identity over unrelated deterministic uses and recycled reference estimates. Previously indexed cohorts and their translated/copy pages were not entered again. No independently sourced new castsWithDrop, totalQuantity, zero-inclusive event histogram, refund-aware actual completed-cast denominator, or authoritative Serevite 190394/190395/190396 rank resolution recovered. All fields remain unknown. Firecrawl source-extraction route unavailable due to transient credit exhaustion; public search results and repo source lineage checked. The primary 2022/2023 original sources still lack a shareable per-operation export; record is a search audit only, not numerical evidence.
